name: IMO Prelim Past Paper
statement:
For positive integer $n$, let $D(n)$ be the eventual value obtained when the digits of $n$ (in base 10) are added up recursively until a one-digit number is obtained. For example $D(4)=4$, $D(2012)=D(5)=5$ and $D(1997)=D(26)=D(8)=8$. If $x$ denotes the 2012th Fibonacci number, find $D(x)$.
F(1)=1,F(2)=1,F(3)=2...
